tools.name: project_db_query
tools.title: Ask the project build database
tools.description: Answers a question about the project's builds from its per-project build database (test reports, build log, effective POM, dependency tree, code-clustering tables, polyglot task state, build events). CPU-only and deterministic: BM25, hashing vectors and exact facets. Every answer line carries provenance: file, line and build id. Facet filters may be written into the question as key:value (kind:flaky, module:core, status:failed).

question.description: The question, e.g. why did the build fail, which code is duplicated, what changed since the last green build, which dependency brings junit, which tests are flaky.

tools.name: project_db_ingest
tools.title: Ingest the project's build data
tools.description: Records the build data the project already has as one new build in its database, incrementally by content hash: unchanged sources are never parsed again. Optionally reads a Maven console log for the build's errors.

buildLog.description: Path of a Maven console log of the build, relative to the project root.
